//ConnectionStrings: Matches docker-compose.yml. With a local PostgreSQL install, override it in user-secrets (see docs/database.md).
//Database: Off so startup never touches the schema, apply a new migration yourself with dotnet ef database update.
//Jwt: Long lived tokens while developing so you stay signed in, production keeps the short ones from appsettings.json.
//RabbitMq: Matches docker-compose.yml. Without it the API uses an in memory bus, so events still work but live only inside the process.
//Email: Mailpit from docker-compose.yml catches every email, open http://localhost:8025 to read them.
